description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers, comparing four distinct combinations represented by different colored lines. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22, and tick labels are present at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, and tick labels are present at intervals of 0.05. The red line, representing "en&es", starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.27 at layer 6, and then declines to about 0.08 at layer 20 before rising to 0.43 at layer 22. The blue line, representing "en&es", begins at around 0.03 at layer 0, reaches a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, decreases to about 0.04 at layer 20, and then increases to 0.38 at layer 22. The green line, representing "en&el", starts at roughly 0.02 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.14 at layer 6, declines to approximately 0.06 at layer 20, and then rises to 0.28 at layer 22. The purple line, representing "en&bn", begins at about 0.02 at layer 0, reaches a peak of around 0.14 at layer 6, decreases to approximately 0.05 at layer 20, and then increases to 0.29 at layer 22.
